name: Atlantic hurricanes
value: No storms; none forecast for 7 days
summary: NHC outlook at 7pm EST on 14 Nov expects no Atlantic tropical cyclone formation in the next 7 days
state: The National Hurricane Center's Tropical Weather Outlook issued at 7pm EST on 14 Nov (00:00 UTC on 15 Nov) says tropical cyclone formation is not expected in the North Atlantic, Caribbean Sea or Gulf during the next 7 days (NHC). No storm is active or threatening land, so the signal stays Normal. The Atlantic season formally ends on 30 Nov.
for_you: No Atlantic storm currently threatens land. Travellers to the Caribbean and Gulf coast can follow the National Hurricane Center and FCDO travel advice for the final weeks of the season.
rubric_hit: No hurricane active or threatening land within 5 days (NHC: no formation expected in 7 days)

sources.title: NOAA National Hurricane Center — Tropical Weather Outlook, Atlantic, 7pm EST 14 Nov

why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).
